Novila gives general advice, not medical advice. Ask a doctor or physiotherapist if you are unsure.

Novila gives general advice on exercise, sleep and food. It is not a medical device, and it does not diagnose, treat or prevent any disease.
Talk to a doctor or physiotherapist before you start training if you have an illness, an injury or pain, are pregnant, or are unsure whether training suits you.
Stop and rest if you feel chest pain, dizziness, shortness of breath or sharp pain. Seek care if it does not pass. In an emergency, call 112.
The coach\'s rehab programs are general and do not replace a plan from your physiotherapist. Follow the pain limit, and your caregiver\'s advice before Novila\'s.
The coach\'s comment is written by Gemini Nano on your phone. AI can be wrong. The program itself is made without AI, and it is what counts.
Activity goals follow the WHO\'s physical activity guidelines, and the nutrition score follows the Swedish Food Agency\'s dietary guidelines. Your own needs can differ.
